raw_segments.text: If Moody Ahab was now all quiescence, at least so far as could be known on deck, Stub, his
second mate, flushed with conquest, betrayed an unusual but still good-natured excitement.
Such an unwanted bustle was he in that the staid Starbuck, his official superior, quietly
resigned to him for the time the sole management of affairs.
One small, helping cause of all this liveliness in Stub was soon made strangely manifest.
He was somewhat intemperately fond of the whale as a flavorish thing to his palate.
